data.hook: At a business forum in The Hague, Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal praised Indian workers for never checking the clock at 5 p.m. or weekends. The comment, meant to attract investors, instead fueled anger over grueling hours.
data.name: Piyush Goyal's Work Ethic Remark Draws Labor Backlash
data.summary: Speaking on October 27 at the India-Netherlands Business Forum, Goyal highlighted India's hardworking workforce as a key draw for Dutch investors, alongside market scale and infrastructure growth. The Karnataka State IT/ITeS Employees Union condemned it as glorifying inhumane overwork, warning of burnout and family strain while calling for stricter labor law enforcement. While some like Harsh Goenka saw it as a nod to India's competitive edge, critics including opposition leaders argued it ignores work-life balance and employee rights, reigniting debates on labor standards.
